# tcpreplay / fuzz_pcap

tcpreplay's own fuzz target `fuzz_pcap` ([source](source/fuzz_pcap.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over tcpreplay (appneta/tcpreplay at c3f6049a).

Opens the input as a pcap via fmemopen/pcap_fopen_offline and runs get_l2len_protocol and get_layer4_v4/v6 / get_ipv6_l4proto on up to 512 packets; results ignored.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against tcpreplay at commit c3f6049a.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch tcpreplay` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_pcap.plain` | 80,784 | `e58709d4c1ba220cc0ed7cc67c789e9f53d4859410d889317df4ebf75cc1634c` |
| ubsan | `fuzz_pcap.ubsan` | 81,536 | `6f1b0b524c6e325908d68397294829aa8968224b24821d12c90fa7ded9f46497` |
| asan | `fuzz_pcap.asan` | 604,504 | `17311ff5e5b3018772ca6b3f3b841f3dde5830d782c486da5fb11161fe33adb2` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_pcap.asan-ubsan` | 605,176 | `5ea411f25808e2291c3dbefd2d3d0c171fe392f9b6575460563a0b1dd6b1ed07` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpcap.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpcap.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpcap.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libpcap.a` (a library from the build image), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime)
